description: Lunar time-scale vectors for mission software: TCL as defined by IAU 2024 Resolution II, the IAU 2000/2006 relations it rests on, published TCL ephemeris rates, leap-second handling from UTC, scale tags, and provisional LTC vectors where no definition is published.

vectors.status_reason: LTC has no published definition (see tag-ltc); this compares a lunar-surface clock model with one published relativistic result, not with LTC
vectors.note: tolerance 1.5 us/day is kshana's choice, not the source's: the published figure depends on the reference surfaces and averaging the model assumes
